notes.decision: Greek loanword ἧπαρ 'liver' with Lyc. ⲍ-onset and possessive prefix ⲡⲉϩ- 'his.' Standard organ-term; here mapped to the cattle (quadrupeds) in the macrocosmic body-schema.
Lyc. plural of ϩⲁⲗⲏⲧ 'birds' (cf. accumulated ⲛⲍⲛⲍⲁⲗⲗⲉⲧⲉ). Birds-in-air paired with fish-in-water and creeping things-on-earth as the canonical three creature-strata.
Lyc. for ⲛϫⲁⲧϥⲉ 'creeping things, reptiles' (with ⲝ for ϫ). The three creature-strata schema (cattle/birds/fish/reptiles) maps body-parts to the visible creation.
Read as 'his outer skin/hide' = ϣⲁⲁⲣ 'skin' in Lyc. orthography. The skin as the outer enclosing surface = ⲥⲁⲃⲧ 'wall' surrounding the cosmos with the great fire (Manichaean firmament-wall motif).
Translated 'the All' tentatively. The form is unusual; could be a Lyc. variant of ⲡⲧⲏⲣϥ̄/ⲡⲧⲏⲣⲥ̄ ('the totality'). Confidence low.

Possibly 'his gall/bile' — semantic field of bitterness (cf. accumulated ⲥⲓϣⲉ 'bitterness'). The bile as bitter humor maps to darkness in the body-schema. Translation deliberately left in apparatus pending parallels.

Lyc. ⲙⲉⲍⲧⲉ = ⲙⲟⲥⲧⲉ 'hatred.' 'His great hatred' identified as the will/desire of some great cosmic principle. Affective interiority mapped onto cosmic geography — characteristic Manichaean correspondence.
ⲙⲟⲟⲙⲉ = 'vein, channel' (per accumulated vocab). His veins = the springs/waters of the cosmos. Direct correspondence: the body's water-channels ARE the cosmic water-channels.
Reading as 'they have given/positioned (in) the middle of the worlds' — ϯ 'give' here in the sense of 'placing.' The five gods are positioned at the cosmological mid-point.
ⲧⲏⲟ̄ likely qualitative 'sown/planted' or 'fastened' (cf. ⲧⲱϩⲉ); 'in him' = within the macrocosmic body. Translated 'established in him' for clarity. Confidence moderate.
Privative ⲛ̄ⲁⲧ- + verbal compound ⲁⲧ-ⲛⲕⲁⲧⲉ ('without sleeping' from ⲛⲕⲟⲧⲕ̄ 'sleep'). 'The Unsleeping (Watchers)' — standard Manichaean designation of the cosmic guardians who never close their eyes.

Greek κάτοχος 'holder, possessor, restrainer' with Lyc. relative ⲫⲉⲧ- prefix. Identifies the first faculty (Mind = ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ) with a cosmic Holder/Restrainer figure. Possibly the Mother of Life or a comparable Manichaean figure who holds back chaos. Retained as Greek term to preserve technical specificity.
'The great King of Honor' — standard Manichaean title (already in accumulated vocab). Here identified with the second faculty, Thought (ⲡⲙⲉⲩⲉ).
ⲑⲃ̄ⲟ = 'humble, abase, bring low' (per accumulated vocab); 3sg.m perfect ⲁϩ- prefix. Subject likely the King of Honor humbling something.

'Palamas of the Light' — identifies the third faculty, Teaching (ⲧⲥⲃⲱ), with this cosmic figure. Cf. accumulated ⲡⲁⲗⲁⲙⲁⲥ 'contriver, cunning craftsman' — but here a positive light-figure, perhaps the cosmic light-craftsman who fashions instruction.
'The King of Glory' — standard Manichaean cosmological figure (κατόχος of the seventh heaven in some traditions, or the Third Ambassador). Identified with the fourth faculty, Counsel (ⲡⲥⲁⲭⲛⲉ).
Lyc. = ⲙⲛ̄ⲧϩⲁⲣϣ̄ϩⲏⲧ 'longsuffering, patience' (literally 'state of long-of-heart'). A virtue.
Greek ὠμοφόρος 'shoulder-bearer' — the cosmic Atlas/Pillar of Glory figure. Identified with the fifth faculty, Reflection (ⲡⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ). Note shift from plural ⲛⲱⲙⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ in earlier vocab.
'The lower side' (per accumulated vocab) — the wisdom that is below, contrasted with the Mind that is above (line 21). Spatial cosmological pairing.
